name: Multilevel terminal block
summary: A multilevel terminal carries two or more documented connection levels within one terminal body.
description: A multilevel terminal carries two or more documented connection levels within one terminal body. Each level needs its electrical identity even when the physical device occupies one terminal-strip position.
readingNotes: Do not connect levels together unless the internal diagram or bridging plan explicitly does so.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Multiple levels do not necessarily share one electrical potential.
